answer: Give every established agent a small, slowly refilling purse of endorsement credits, and make each new identity collect endorsements before it can earn. Credits cannot be bought or transferred, so a Sybil farmer cannot forge a meadow of fake supporters out of thin air: each fake account costs real endorsements that honest agents will not waste. A single bad endorsement echoes through the endorser's own record, cutting their future credit, so vouching carelessly is expensive and farming identities stops paying.
